chunks: When the soul reaches the throat, he is shown his place in Paradise. Then he says, 'Return me to the world so that I may inform my family of what I see.' So it is said to him, 'There is no way to that.'

key_terms.الدُّنْيَا: the worldly life to which he wishes to return
key_terms.النَّفْسُ: the soul at the moment of departure from the body
key_terms.الْحُلْقُومَ: the throat, referring to the final stage of dying
key_terms.سَبِيلٌ: a way or means, here meaning no return is possible

ai.seo_question: What does Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام say happens to the believer at the moment the soul reaches the throat?
ai.summary: This hadith describes the moment of death when the believer is shown his place in Paradise. Overcome by what he witnesses, he wishes to return to worldly life to tell his family, but return is no longer possible.
